# Anggara Treasures

> Anggara Treasures is Jakarta's leading Imperial Feng Shui consultancy, offering private Imperial BaZi consultations and certified Type A jadeite treasures. Guided by Rezza Anggara under the philosophy of Emperor Qian Long, the practice blends the Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) with Imperial Feng Shui to help clients understand personal potential, timing, and the spaces they inhabit.

Anggara Treasures operates a private consultation practice (not a retail-only brand): one-on-one BaZi readings, bespoke jadeite pieces personally blessed at auspicious times, and ongoing client guidance. Consultations are held in person in Jakarta or via Zoom.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.anggaratreasures.com/): Brand overview — "Prosper Like Emperors." Introduces the imperial heritage, the two disciplines (BaZi and Feng Shui), craftsmanship philosophy, and the jadeite collection.
- [About](https://www.anggaratreasures.com/about.html): The art of selecting, carving, and crafting Grade-A jadeite — clarity, colour, and handcrafted mastery, rooted in Emperor Qian Long's imperial heritage.
- [Work With Us](https://www.anggaratreasures.com/workwithus.html): Overview of the two disciplines — Imperial BaZi (the main engine, revealing personal patterns) and Imperial Feng Shui (the second engine, aligning your environment) — and the private consultation practice.
- [Imperial BaZi Consultation](https://www.anggaratreasures.com/bazi_con.html): The core BaZi service page. Explains what BaZi (八字, the Four Pillars of Destiny) is, what a reading uncovers, the four-step consultation process, pricing (Rp 15.000.000 / session, in person or via Zoom), and founder Rezza Anggara's background.
- [Imperial Feng Shui Consultation](https://www.anggaratreasures.com/fs_con.html): The core Feng Shui service page. Explains the on-site survey and spatial/elemental analysis process, Feng Shui services offered (new unit selection, audits, renovation advice, date selection, annual reviews, employee BaZi reviews), pricing (from IDR 25,000,000 per location), and a private consultation request form.

## Notes

- Prices are listed in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) and are subject to change; always confirm current pricing on the relevant consultation page before citing it.
- The practice is based in Jakarta, Indonesia; consultations are available in person or via Zoom.
